```{ojs}
mutable rngSeed = 1
mutable meanHistory = []
mutable resampleClicks = 0
mutable resetClicks = 0
mutable lastSamplesPerClick = 1
```

```{ojs}
// Edge-trigger the Reset
{
  if (reset > resetClicks) {
    mutable meanHistory = [];
    mutable resetClicks = reset;
  }
  return html``;
}

// Reset resampleClicks when samplesPerClick changes
{
  if (controls.samplesPerClick !== lastSamplesPerClick) {
    mutable lastSamplesPerClick = controls.samplesPerClick;
    mutable resampleClicks = 0; // Reset to match the new button's counter
  }
  return html``;
}

// Edge-trigger the Resample: add current mean to history then generate new sample
{
  if (resample > resampleClicks) {
    // Add the current mean to history first
    mutable meanHistory = [...meanHistory, xbar];
    
    // If doing multiple samples, add the additional ones
    if (controls.samplesPerClick > 1) {
      const additionalMeans = [];
      for (let i = 1; i < controls.samplesPerClick; i++) {
        const rand = d3.randomNormal.source(d3.randomLcg(rngSeed + i))(controls.trueMu, controls.trueSigma);
        const sample = d3.range(controls.n).map(rand);
        additionalMeans.push(d3.mean(sample));
      }
      mutable meanHistory = [...meanHistory, ...additionalMeans];
    }
    
    // Update seed for next sample (which will be displayed)
    mutable rngSeed = rngSeed + controls.samplesPerClick;
    mutable resampleClicks = resample;
  }
  return html``;
}
```


```{ojs}
// Helper to make a styled Inputs.button
function styledButton(label, cls, options = {}) {
  const el = Inputs.button(label, options);
  const btn = el.querySelector('button');
  if (btn) btn.classList.add(cls);
  return el;
}

// Define themed buttons with updated label for multi-sample
viewof resample = styledButton(
  controls.samplesPerClick > 1 
    ? `Resample (×${controls.samplesPerClick})` 
    : "Resample", 
  "btn-resample", 
  { reduce: c => (c ?? 0) + 1 }
);

viewof reset = styledButton("Reset", "btn-reset", {
  reduce: c => (c ?? 0) + 1
});

// --- Current sample (always visible) ---
X = {
  const rand = d3.randomNormal.source(d3.randomLcg(rngSeed))(controls.trueMu, controls.trueSigma);
  return d3.range(controls.n).map(rand);
}
xbar = d3.mean(X)

// ========= Left panel: current sample ========= 
// Compute histogram bins and densities once 
leftBins = d3.bin().domain(xDomain).thresholds(controls.bins)(X)
leftDensities = leftBins.map(b => b.length / controls.n / Math.max(1e-9, b.x1 - b.x0) )
leftYMax = Math.max(0.1, d3.max(leftDensities) || 0.1);

// ========= Shared computation =========
xPad = 3 * controls.trueSigma
xDomain = [controls.trueMu - xPad, controls.trueMu + xPad]
mid      = 0.5 * (xDomain[0] + xDomain[1]);
anchor   = xbar < mid ? "start" : "end";   // right of line if on left half, else left

leftPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(600, Math.max(320, width/2 - 20)),
  height: 320,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 14,
  },
  x: { label: "Data", domain: xDomain },
  y: { label: "Density", domain: [0, leftYMax * 1.1] },
  marks: [
    // histogram
    Plot.rectY(leftBins, {
      x1: d => d.x0,
      x2: d => d.x1,
      y: d => d.length / controls.n / Math.max(1e-9, d.x1 - d.x0),
      fill: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      fillOpacity: 0.4
    }),

    // ticks at data points
    Plot.ruleX(X, {
      y1: 0,
      y2: leftYMax * 0.05,
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-1)",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      strokeOpacity: 0.8
    }),

    // sample mean line + label
    Plot.ruleX([xbar], {
      stroke: "currentColor",
      strokeDasharray: "4,3",
      strokeWidth: 2
    }),
    // label 
    Plot.text([xbar], {
      x: d => d,
      y: leftYMax * 0.95,
      text: d => `x̄ = ${d.toFixed(2)}`,
      textAnchor: anchor,
      dx: xbar < mid ? 8 : -8,
      dy: -2,
      fontSize: 14,
      fill: "currentColor"
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
  ]
});

// ========= Right panel: saved sample means =========
means = meanHistory

// Domain for right panel
mPad = 3 * controls.trueSigma / Math.sqrt(controls.n)
mDomain = means.length > 0 
  ? [
      Math.min(d3.min(means), controls.trueMu - mPad, xbar - 0.1),
      Math.max(d3.max(means), controls.trueMu + mPad, xbar + 0.1)
    ]
  : [controls.trueMu - mPad, controls.trueMu + mPad]

// True distribution PDF
sampleMeanPdf = (x) => {
  const variance = controls.trueSigma ** 2 / controls.n;
  return (1 / Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI * variance)) *
    Math.exp(-((x - controls.trueMu) ** 2) / (2 * variance));
}

pdfData = d3.range(mDomain[0], mDomain[1], (mDomain[1] - mDomain[0]) / 200)
  .map(x => ({ x, y: sampleMeanPdf(x) }));

// Compute histogram for means if we have any
rightBins = means.length > 0 
  ? d3.bin().domain(mDomain).thresholds(controls.bins)(means)
  : [];
rightDensities = rightBins.map(b => 
  b.length / means.length / Math.max(1e-9, b.x1 - b.x0)
);
rightYMax = Math.max(
  d3.max(rightDensities) || 0.1,
  controls.showTrue ? d3.max(pdfData, d => d.y) || 0.1 : 0.1
);

rightPlot = Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(600, Math.max(320, width/2 - 20)),
  height: 320,
  style: {
    background: "var(--plot-bg)",
    color: "var(--plot-fg)",
    fontFamily: bodyFont,
    fontSize: 14,
  },
  x: { label: "x̄", domain: mDomain },
  y: { label: "Density", domain: [0, rightYMax * 1.1] },
  marks: [
    // Histogram of means
    means.length > 0 ? Plot.rectY(
      rightBins,
      {
        x1: d => d.x0,
        x2: d => d.x1,
        y: d => d.length / means.length / (d.x1 - d.x0),
        fill: "var(--plot-series-4)",
        fillOpacity: 0.3
      }
    ) : null,
    // Vertical lines for saved means (like left plot)
    means.length > 0 ? Plot.ruleX(means, {
      y1: 0,
      y2: rightYMax * 0.05,
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      strokeOpacity: 0.8
    }) : null,
    // Current sample mean (not yet in history)
    Plot.ruleX([xbar], {
      y1: 0,
      y2: rightYMax * 0.07,
      stroke: "currentColor",
      strokeWidth: 3,
      strokeOpacity: 1
    }),
    // Label for current mean
    Plot.text([xbar], {
      x: d => d,
      y: rightYMax * 0.08,
      text: "current",
      textAnchor: "middle",
      fontSize: 10,
      fill: "currentColor"
    }),
    // True distribution
    Plot.line(pdfData, {
      x: "x",
      y: "y",
      strokeWidth: 2,
      stroke: "var(--plot-series-4)",
      strokeOpacity: controls.showTrue ? 1 : 0
    }),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ].filter(d => d !== null)
})

// ========= Display =========
{
  for (const f of [viewof resample, viewof reset]) {
    f.style.margin = "0";
    f.style.width = "100%";
    f.style.maxWidth = "none";
    f.style.display = "flex";
  }
  viewof resample.style.justifyContent = "flex-start";
  viewof reset.style.justifyContent = "flex-end";

  return html`<div class="ojs-toolbar-grid">
    <div class="left">${viewof resample}</div>
    <div class="center">
      <div>${tex`\bar{x} = ${xbar.toFixed(2)}`}</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.8em; opacity:0.7">
        ${means.length} sample${means.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} collected
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="right">${viewof reset}</div>
  </div>

  <style>
    .ojs-toolbar-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;
      align-items:center;
      width:100%;
      box-sizing:border-box;
      margin:0; padding:0;
    }
    .ojs-toolbar-grid form{
      margin:0 !important;
      width:100% !important;
      max-width:none !important;
      display:flex !important;
    }
    .ojs-toolbar-grid .left form{ justify-content:flex-start !important; }
    .ojs-toolbar-grid .right form{ justify-content:flex-end !important; }

    .btn.btn-resample{ background: var(--brand-teal); color:#fff; border:none; }
    .btn.btn-resample:hover{ background: var(--brand-teal-hover); }
    .btn.btn-reset{ background: var(--brand-red); color:#fff; border:none; }
    .btn.btn-reset:hover{ background: var(--brand-red-hover); }
    .btn.btn-resample:focus-visible,
    .btn.btn-reset:focus-visible{
      outline: 2px solid currentColor;
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .ojs-toolbar-grid .center{
      text-align:center;
      font-size:0.9rem;
      color: var(--brand-fg);
    }
  </style>`;
}

html`<div style="max-width:100%; display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:flex-start; flex-wrap:nowrap;">
  <div>${leftPlot}</div>
  <div>${rightPlot}</div>
</div>`
```

```{ojs}
viewof controls = {
  const leftForm = Inputs.form({
    n: Inputs.range([1, 400], { value: 10, step: 1, label: md`${tex`n`}` }),
    trueMu: Inputs.range([-2, 2], { value: 0, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\mu_{\text{true}}`}` }),
    trueSigma: Inputs.range([0.3, 3], { value: 1, step: 0.1, label: md`${tex`\sigma_{\text{true}}`}` })
  }, { submit: false });

  const rightForm = Inputs.form({
    samplesPerClick: Inputs.range([1, 10], { 
      value: 1, 
      step: 1, 
      label: "Samples per click" 
    }),
    bins: Inputs.range([10, 60], { value: 24, step: 1, label: "Histogram bins" }),
    showTrue: Inputs.toggle({ label: md`Show ${tex`\bar{X}`} distribution`, value: false })
  }, { submit: false });

  const root = html`<details class="controls-root" open>
    <summary>Simulation controls</summary>
    <div class="controls-grid">
      <div class="controls-col"><h4>Data & truth</h4></div>
      <div class="controls-col"><h4>Display & actions</h4></div>
    </div>
  </details>`;
  
  root.querySelector(".controls-grid").children[0].append(leftForm);
  root.querySelector(".controls-grid").children[1].append(rightForm);

  const getValue = () => ({ ...leftForm.value, ...rightForm.value });
  const update = () => {
    root.value = getValue();
    root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };

  leftForm.addEventListener("input", update);
  rightForm.addEventListener("input", update);

  queueMicrotask(update);
  return root;
}
```
